proposed_comments.title: (1/3) Share one hit-test deadline
proposed_comments.body:
### (1/3) Share one hit-test deadline

**Severity:** `medium`

`ResolveTitleBarWindow` is called from the low-level `MouseProc` hook and can query up to 32 ancestors. Giving every `WM_NCHITTEST` call a fresh 100 ms timeout lets a chain of responsive-but-slow `HTTRANSPARENT` windows accumulate far beyond the intended budget, delaying mouse input and risking hook timeout. Rename this to a total budget and establish one deadline before the loop; apply this together with (2/3) and (3/3).

```suggestion
    constexpr UINT HIT_TEST_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_MS = 100;
```

confidence.rationale: The exact upstream loop gives every ancestor call the full 100 ms and can run from MouseProc; the cumulative worst case follows directly from the depth cap, though no slow-window timing test was run.

proposed_comments.title: (2/3) Start the deadline before the loop
proposed_comments.body:
### (2/3) Start the deadline before the loop

**Severity:** `medium`

The hit-test loop currently has only a per-call timeout, so walking several transparent ancestors can consume a fresh 100 ms at each level while the low-level mouse hook is waiting. Record the shared deadline once before entering the loop, then use the remaining time for each call as in (3/3).

```suggestion
    const ULONGLONG deadline = GetTickCount64() + HIT_TEST_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_MS;
    for (int depth = 0; hwnd && depth < MAX_DEPTH; depth++)
```

confidence.rationale: The upstream loop lacks a shared deadline; this one-line insertion is directly tied to the per-call timeout behavior and was included in the exact candidate build.

proposed_comments.title: Defer title-bar click replay on every pending exit
proposed_comments.body:
### Defer title-bar click replay on every pending exit

**Severity:** `medium`

The normal pending title-bar release posts `WM_REPLAY_CLICK` so `SendInput` runs after `MouseProc` returns, but the same title-bar interaction can also exit through `RecoverStaleInteraction` or the failed-`BeginInteraction` branch in `HandleMouseEvent`; both still call `ReplayPendingClick` synchronously from the hook. Please route title-bar replay through the deferred message on those exits too, while preserving modifier completion and the ordering of any newly arriving button-down; leave the existing modifier-session replay behavior unchanged. Verify normal release, stale recovery with an overlapping button-down, and failed begin each deliver the click once and preserve input order.

confidence.rationale: The pinned call paths show SendInput in ReplayPendingClick and synchronous calls from stale recovery and failed begin, contrasting with the deferred normal release; ordering requires coordinated control-flow changes and was not interaction-tested.
